verdict.rationale: Supabase documents a Management API for running organizations and projects programmatically (docs-28), and a probe found a live OpenAPI spec at supabase.com/openapi.json (probe-3). It also auto-generates REST and GraphQL APIs from the database schema (docs-27, docs-42), so both the platform and the data layer can be driven through documented public APIs. Missing for 10: no hands-on authenticated call to the Management API showing it works end to end, and the pack gives no detail on API auth, scope or rate limits.
